body.statement:
Let \(\xi_n^0=(p_n/n,\gamma,\lambda,R)\), \(\widehat d_n=d(\widehat\xi_n)\), and \(I_\gamma=\mathbb E[Z^2\sigma(\gamma Z)\{1-\sigma(\gamma Z)\}]\).  On every compact set \(K\subset(0,\kappa_{\mathrm{bal}})\times(\underline\gamma,\overline\gamma)\times(0,\infty)^2\) on which the four-distance map is continuously differentiable and
\[
 \inf_{\xi\in K}\min\{d_{\mathrm{bal}}(\xi),d_{\mathrm{rad}}(\xi),d_{\mathrm{col}}(\xi),d_0(\xi)\}>0,
 \qquad
 \inf_{\xi\in K}\|\partial_\gamma d(\xi)\|_\infty>0,
\]
uniformly in \(\xi\in K\),
\[
 \sqrt n\{\widehat d_n-d(\xi_n^0)\}\Rightarrow\mathcal N_4\!\left(0,\Omega(\xi)\right),\qquad
 \Omega(\xi)=\frac{\partial_\gamma d(\xi)\partial_\gamma d(\xi)^\top}{I_\gamma},\qquad
 \widehat\Omega_n\to_{\mathbb P}\Omega(\xi).
\]
Consequently, the simultaneous intervals \([\widehat d_{\ell n}-\widehat u_{n,1-\alpha},\widehat d_{\ell n}+\widehat u_{n,1-\alpha}]\), \(\ell\in\{\mathrm{bal},\mathrm{rad},\mathrm{col},0\}\), have joint coverage at least \(1-\alpha+o(1)\) uniformly on \(K\), and
\[
 \sup_{\xi\in K}\mathbb P_\xi\{\widehat s_{n,\alpha}\ne\operatorname{sgn}(\Delta_{\mathrm{HIR}}(\xi))\}\to0,
\]
where abstention counts as an error.  Thus the classifier is total, reports \(\bot\) whenever a certificate is missing or an estimated boundary distance fails to exceed \(\widehat u_{n,1-\alpha}\), and is uniformly nonabstaining and sign-consistent on compact margin-separated, derivative-nondegenerate sets.
body.justification: A deterministic diagram is operational only if its phase label can be learned from a trial away from nonregular boundaries.
body.gap: SurCandes2019 estimates scalar states for one logistic MLE and LuYangWang2025 estimates quadratic variance components; neither gives joint inference for a contrast of dependent optimized policy criteria.
body.consumer: The theorem supplies an uncertainty-aware label for whether entropy balancing improves or worsens targeting regret in a feature-expanded trial reanalysis.

obligation.what_is_open: The certified branch map, its derivatives, and their uniform plug-in consistency, all of which depend on resolving the joint deterministic system.
obligation.obstruction: The scalar signal estimator has a regular limit, but the frozen handle supplies no explicit state equations or proved globally selected branch to differentiate. The original coverage claim also omits derivative nondegeneracy and can use a zero-width critical radius.
obligation.attempted: The logistic score expansion, information consistency, and the conditional delta-method covariance were derived. A statement narrowing adds the minimal derivative nondegeneracy needed by the defined Gaussian-max quantile, without assuming the unresolved optimizer theorem.
obligation.partial_result:
The scalar statistical component is closed: uniformly on compact subsets of the interior signal interval,
\[
 \sqrt n(\widehat\gamma_n-\gamma)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,I_\gamma^{-1}),
 \qquad \widehat I_{\gamma,n}\to_{\mathbb P}I_\gamma.
\]
If a certified branch supplied a continuously differentiable distance map, the delta-method covariance would be \(\partial_\gamma d\,\partial_\gamma d^{\top}/I_\gamma\).  The frozen joint system does not yet supply that branch or its derivatives.  In addition, positive simultaneous-radius coverage requires the stated derivative nondegeneracy; otherwise the defined Gaussian-max radius can be exactly zero.
